goal.objective: Repair release-review source provenance and replace the npm 11 masking adapter with production-owned, operation-contained, distinct empty npm configuration files while preserving the real copied-production lifecycle proof.

assumptions.statement: Executable provenance, offline-cache provenance, process isolation, and hostile same-user resistance remain external-host duties.
assumptions.rationale: Repository code can validate supplied boundaries but cannot enforce the host runtime.

assumptions.statement: Independent review, V11 refresh, candidate gate, R2, hosted CI, and merge remain integration-owner work.
assumptions.rationale: The producer cannot approve its own release.

assumptions.statement: Invocation-specific private config paths may vary while their containment policy and empty-file identities remain stable.
assumptions.rationale: Stable reconstruction must bind security semantics without binding disposable absolute paths.

assumptions.statement: The immutable Revision 22 pre-edit snapshots are the only authoritative producer inputs for editable source.
assumptions.rationale: Revision 21 demonstrated that a digest-only uncommitted intermediate cannot support a trusted launch.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every producer input reconstructs, npm 11 runs only with two authenticated private empty config files, host npm configuration stays excluded, and the complete copied-production lifecycle remains exact.

evidenceRequirements.description: Provide exact snapshot and output identities, private config evidence, npm 11 inspection, fixture lifecycle, package pair, handoff fan-in, receipts, negative routes, commands, and cleanup.

contextSources.description: Repository workflow, provenance, diagnosis, and specialist trust invariants.
Exact raw package-bound Revision 21 block handoff.
Immutable V11 verification of the Revision 21 block.
Closed Revision 22 provenance and npm-config correction contract.
Exact integration-owner provenance and npm 11 reproductions.
Normative IDE-neutral host and specialist execution boundary.

forbiddenEffects: Do not edit immutable snapshots, frozen gate or verifier source, package metadata, lockfile, or prior evidence; mutate Git state; use network access; launch descendants; refresh V11; run release phases against the real repository; claim release readiness; or merge.

workUnits.objective: Implement and verify reconstructable source provenance plus production-owned private npm configuration across parent, harness, receipts, and lifecycle tests.

module.action: Authenticate immutable pre-edit source, create and validate distinct operation-contained npm configs, remove the masking adapter, and prove the real lifecycle and cleanup.

stopConditions: Do not include invocation-specific temporary config paths in the stable runtime identity.
Do not restore host npm configuration or retain the Revision 21 adapter.
Keep every fixture and config file outside the source repository and remove it on both pass and failure.
Reject config aliasing, substitution, links, non-empty bytes, missing files, and out-of-operation-root paths before npm spawn.
Run every required command and return only the generated closed SpecialistAgentHandoff JSON.
Stop before editing unless every immutable input and corresponding live pre-edit source matches exactly.
The positive test must invoke the copied production gate, parents, harness phases, and verifier in separate real processes.
